# Generated by `cargo run -p agent_docs` from the diagnostic registry and compiler/tests/ui; do not edit.
title: "V8002 reserved_package_name"
description: "sakura.toml names its package std or main (design §9)."
---

An error from the `package` phase. `sakura explain V8002` prints this explanation offline.

`sakura.toml` names its package `std` or `main` (design §9). The first segment of an
import is a package name: `std` is the standard library and `main` is the package of a file run
without a manifest, so a package under either name would make `import std/…` or `import main/…`
mean two things.

Wrong:

```toml
[package]
name = "main"
```

Fixed:

```toml
[package]
name = "billing"
```
